### Summary I like to use uv audit as an aborting part of the pipeline to enforce a strong trend to fix CVEs as soon as possible. That contradicts with the exclude-newer option that often demands a while between CVE and and available fix. ### The Core Problem A circular deadlock occurs between two CI enforcement rules: uv audit + ignore-until-fixed: Tells the pipeline to stop ignoring a vulnerability the exact moment a patch is released upstream. --exclude-newer: Forbids the package resolver from installing that same patch because it is too new (quarantined). Result: The pipeline fails because a fix exists, but the team cannot install the fix without violating their release quarantine policy. #### Options to Fix the Gap 1. Redefine "Fixed" as "Installable" (Boolean Flag) How it works: Change the condition of ignore-until-fixed so it only triggers if the patched version is actually eligible to be installed under current resolver constraints (including --exclude-newer). CLI/Config: --ignore-until-installable or --bridge-quarantine Effect: The CVE continues to be ignored (or outputs a warning) until the release passes the quarantine window and becomes installable. 2. Risk-Based Quarantine Exemption (CVSS Threshold) How it works: Introduce a severity score cutoff for quarantined fixes. CLI/Config: --quarantine-max-cvss 7.0 Effect: CVSS < 7.0 (Low/Medium): Stays ignored while the fix is in the quarantine window to avoid pipeline churn. CVSS ≥ 7.0 (High/Critical): Hard-fails the pipeline immediately, forcing maintainers to prioritize an emergency rollout. 3. Automatic Security Carve-Out (Selective Bypass) How it works: Keep uv audit strict, but allow the package resolver to automatically exempt a specific dependency from --exclude-newer if the newer version resolves an active CVE. CLI/Config: --allow-newer-for-cve Effect: The rest of the dependency tree stays locked to the quarantine timestamp, while only the patched library is allowed past the gate. ### Example ```mermaid flowchart TD A([Start: uv audit]) --> B{Advisory found?} B -- No --> Pass([Audit PASS]) B -- Yes --> C{Fix published upstream?} %% No fix available C -- No --> CheckIgnore{ignore-until-fixed?} CheckIgnore -- Yes --> WarnPass([PASS with Warning
No fix exists]) CheckIgnore -- No --> FailHard([FAIL: Advisory active]) %% Fix available upstream C -- Yes --> D{Fix satisfies
--exclude-newer?} D -- Yes --> Actionable[Fix is INSTALLABLE
Run uv lock --upgrade-package] --> FailActionable([FAIL: Actionable fix available]) %% Gap: Fix exists but is quarantined D -- No --> BridgeCheck{Extension Mode
Configured?} %% Standard behavior (Current Deadlock) BridgeCheck -- None / Disabled --> FailDeadlock([FAIL: Fix blocked by exclude-newer
DEADLOCK]) %% Mode 1: Boolean Flag BridgeCheck -- Boolean Flag
e.g. bridge-quarantine --> WarnQuarantine([PASS with Warning
Fix in quarantine window]) %% Mode 2: CVSS Severity Threshold BridgeCheck -- Threshold Set
e.g. cvss-threshold=7.0 --> CheckCVSS{CVSS < Threshold?} CheckCVSS -- Yes: Low / Medium --> WarnQuarantine CheckCVSS -- No: High / Critical --> FailCritical([FAIL: High-Severity Zero-Day
Immediate action required]) classDef pass fill:#e6f4ea,stroke:#137333,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#0d652d; classDef fail fill:#fce8e6,stroke:#c5221f,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#a50e0e; classDef newPath fill:#e8f0fe,stroke:#1a73e8,stroke-width:2px,color:#174ea6; classDef logic fill:#fef7e0,stroke:#ea8600,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#b06000; class Pass,WarnPass pass; class FailHard,FailActionable,FailDeadlock,FailCritical fail; class WarnQuarantine newPath; class BridgeCheck,CheckCVSS,D,CheckIgnore,C,B logic; ```
title: Close gap between exclude-newer and audits ignore-until-fixed
